notes.title: SNAP SNAP. Update.
notes.notes:
Salam alaikum batyrs and jigitki. 😎

We have prepared an update for SNAP SNAP.

1. fixed minor bugs related to saving.
2. Improved interaction with some items.
3. Improved operation of some sounds.
4. Added highlighting for text in the dark.
5. Added the ability to skip a tape when listening to it again.
6. Fixed a bug with the final banner. 
7. Added text describing a gift from us before the final banner. We will tell about it here as well:
- The first player who finds the 8th tape will receive a gift—a free subscription to all our future games. We will be sending you a key to each of our new games as they are released. When you find the 8th tape, we will receive an email notification with your nickname, and will contact you via Steam.
8. Added visuals when listening to cassette 8.
9. Improved some widgets
10. Improved work of jumpscares
11. Added mouse inversion.
12. Added user agreement
